question: Should persisted yielded main sessions use this PR's `paused`/`sessions_yield` contract, or align with the broader `deferred` terminology proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95996?
rationale: The selected value is persisted and exposed through Gateway rows, session tools, Control UI, and Workboard, so its name and semantics become an upgrade-sensitive contract.

options.title: Adopt paused now
options.body: Approve this narrower, well-proven session contract and handle any later vocabulary unification through an explicit migration.

options.title: Align to deferred first
options.body: Hold the PR and mechanically rename the persisted session contract after deciding the broader yielded-parent terminology.

options.title: Use reason metadata only
options.body: Preserve the prior status union and represent yielded waiting solely through a dedicated lifecycle reason.

recommendation.title: Adopt paused now
recommendation.body: Approve this narrower, well-proven session contract and handle any later vocabulary unification through an explicit migration.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing yielded-subagent pause semantics and has the strongest relevant merged history.
